name: How do change the margin to wide

steps.tooltip: Click the Page Layout tab to access page setup options.
steps.explanation: This tab contains options for page setup, including document margins.

steps.tooltip: Click Margins to see available margin presets.
steps.explanation: This opens a dropdown menu with different margin configurations for your worksheet.

steps.tooltip: Select Wide to apply a wider margin setting to your document.
steps.explanation: Choosing 'Wide' will set the top, bottom, left, and right margins to a larger value.
